entries.title: Competing platform exclusivity in Territory
entries.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates must not enter into or perform reseller, referral, implementation, alliance, or partnership agreements with any provider of a Competing Platform in the Territory during the term and for 6 months thereafter.
entries.quote: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, Partner shall not, and shall procure that its Affiliates shall not, enter into or perform any reseller, referral, implementation, alliance or partnership agreement with the provider of any Competing Platform in respect of the Territory.

relatedClauses.quote: "Affiliate" means any entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a party.

"Competing Platform" means any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse or data platform product that competes with Zephyr Lakehouse, including without limitation those listed in Schedule 1, as Zephyr may update on thirty (30) days' notice.
"Territory" means India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam.

Clause 7.1 does not prevent Partner from performing services on a Competing Platform where the end customer has independently selected that platform before Partner's involvement and Partner receives no fee, margin or incentive from the provider of the Competing Platform.

entries.notes: Carve-out in Clause 7.2 permits servicing competing platforms if independently chosen by the end customer prior to AtliQ's involvement and AtliQ receives no compensation from the platform provider.

entries.title: Right of first refusal for Indian BFSI opportunities
entries.summary: Before proposing any data platform, engineering, or analytics services for an Indian BFSI opportunity exceeding USD 50,000, AtliQ must notify Zephyr and offer it the right to be proposed as the primary platform, allowing 15 business days for response.
entries.quote: Before submitting any proposal for a BFSI Opportunity, Partner shall notify Zephyr in writing (with reasonable details of the opportunity) and offer Zephyr the right to be proposed as the data platform.

relatedClauses.quote: "BFSI Opportunity" means any opportunity known to Partner or its Affiliates to provide data platform, data engineering or analytics services to a bank, non-banking financial company, insurer or other financial-services institution in India with an expected contract value exceeding USD 50,000.

Zephyr shall have fifteen (15) business days from notification to accept. If Zephyr accepts, Partner shall propose Zephyr Lakehouse as the primary platform in good faith. If Zephyr declines or does not respond, Partner may proceed on any platform, subject to Clause 7.
Partner shall maintain a written log of BFSI Opportunities and notifications, available to Zephyr on request.

entries.title: Minimum certified engineers requirement
entries.summary: AtliQ must maintain at least three Zephyr-certified engineers at all times during the term of the partnership.
entries.quote: Partner shall maintain at least three (3) Zephyr-certified engineers at all times.
